budget.extraInputEstimateMethod: Measured extra UTF-8 request bytes, heuristic 2–5 bytes/token, cache writes at $0.125/M. Not a tokenizer or provider quote.
budget.reservationBasis: 1.05M input tokens at maximum long-context cache-write rate $0.25/M plus 128K output at long-context rate $0.75/M = $0.3585; rounded up. Standard global endpoint only.
uncertainty: vision input tokenization and hidden formatting
account access and quota not probed

artifacts: unblind mapping and final per-site verdict

conditions: spent plus worst-case next reservation exceeds approved cap
stop.beforeFetch: durably consume one call slot and reserve cost before any dispatch
stop.onUncertainty: retain reservation, halt cohort, never retry automatically
stop.onPartialPair: preserve both successful and failed evidence; pair not evaluable if either response unavailable

evaluation.reviewers: independent of the paid generator; fresh-context or external review preferred; no extra paid evaluator call
evaluation.blinding: neutral random IDs; remove version/model and old scores; randomize presentation within each site; same neutral rendering; lock notes before unblinding
evaluation.residualBias: schema/style may reveal version; current implementer already knows V2; no claim of perfect blinding or full external independence
evaluation.comparisonUnit: visually grounded page interval/moment, not moment number which may differ between versions
evaluation.causalLimit: One pair per site measures prompt+schema jointly; no separation of their effects or proof of reliability on unknown sites. All <8 scores and failures remain visible.
evaluation.remainingB1: eight references remain in scope of improvement; no additional calls prepared; Salterra requires capture repair/certification before artistic evaluation
